note: Pinned versions for everything this vault depends on. Obsidian plugin files are installed per machine under .obsidian/plugins (gitignored); hashes are SHA-256 of the release assets that were installed here.

obsidian_plugins.name: Agent Client
obsidian_plugins.author: RAIT-09
obsidian_plugins.note: Checked against the GitHub releases on 2026-09-03: 0.12.1 (2026-08-14) is the latest release, so the copied files were kept.

obsidian_plugins.name: Writing Studio
obsidian_plugins.author: Don Pucik
obsidian_plugins.note: Installed with plugins/writing-studio-no-startup-restore.patch so a workspace-restored launcher does not activate Writing Studio while Open on startup is disabled. The same patch adds a visible return to YouTube to blog in the Launcher and Binder. Deliberate launcher commands still activate it.

obsidian_plugins.name: Home tab
obsidian_plugins.author: Renso
obsidian_plugins.license: not stated in the manifest; see the upstream repository
obsidian_plugins.note: Replaced by youtubetoblog-home on 2026-09-03 and removed from community-plugins.json so that two plugins do not fight over empty tabs. Display only: new tabs open a search page with recent files and bookmarks. Files copied from the AIMH Home vault install (version 1.2.2 per manifest.json); the source URL is the authorUrl from the manifest plus the repository name.

obsidian_plugins.name: Commander
obsidian_plugins.author: jsmorabito & phibr0
obsidian_plugins.note: Replaced by youtubetoblog-home on 2026-09-03 and removed from community-plugins.json. The vault-owned sidebar now carries New chat without an overlapping layout plugin. Files remain installed for reversible rollback.

obsidian_plugins.name: youtubetoblog Home
obsidian_plugins.author: Daniel Agrici
obsidian_plugins.note: Vault-local plugin, canonical source in plugins/youtubetoblog-home; copied into .obsidian/plugins/youtubetoblog-home. Owns the landing page and default left sidebar, including New chat, two-way saved-source promotion, dedicated app-page navigation and live counts. On first load it provisions the Writing Studio project over 03 Blogs, selects it, and disables overlapping frontmatter and daily-note writes. Hashes are of the source files.

obsidian_plugins.name: RSS Dashboard
obsidian_plugins.author: Aditya Amatya
obsidian_plugins.note: Discovery, reader and selective saved-source surface only. Built locally from the pinned upstream tag with plugins/rss-dashboard-safe-save.patch, which refuses same-title collisions and YAML-quotes untrusted saved-note metadata. Do not replace it with an unpatched community build. Vault Shards v2 data and metadata are stored in 01 Queue/RSS Dashboard Data.

acp_adapters.note: Updated from 0.70.0 on 2026-09-03 (npm latest). Under a Flatpak Obsidian, point Agent Client at a wrapper script that execs node with the adapter's dist/index.js; the plugin resolves a bare command name through a login shell, so ~/.local/bin/claude-agent-acp is found when it is on the login PATH.

claude_code_plugins.note: Only read .avt output and keep it untouched with attribution; the format and trademark belong to its author.
Optional paid image generation; the Gemini key is supplied only as the plugin's sensitive user config google_ai_api_key.
